title: Erinnya Eryaweebwa Nga Tannazaalibwa
intro: Kuba akafaananyi ng’ekifo ekitukuvu ekisirifu ekijjudde okwegayirira okw’amaanyi oluvannyuma lw’okulindirira okumala emyaka mingi. Mu bitalabika mwe muva eky’okuddamu ekitwala erinnya eritaweebwangako, nga kisuubiza amagezi okuva mu myaka egyasooka n’obulamu obumanyiddwa olw’okwewaayo, okusaasira, n’obulongoofu.
clues: Natuumibwa erinnya Allah yennyini nga sinnazaalibwa, n’erinnya eritaweebwangako muntu yenna eyasooka nze.
Nnakkirizibwa ng’eky’okuddamu mu kwegayirira okw’amaanyi okuva mu bazadde abakadde abaali balowooza nti okuzaala tekusoboka.
Naweebwa amagezi, okusalawo, n’Ebyawandiikibwa nga nkyali muto.
Nnali nvunaanyizibwa eri bazadde bange era nga nsaasira abalala, era saali wa malala oba omujeemu.
Allah yandagira emirembe ku lunaku lwe nazaalibwa, olunaku lwe nfa, n’olunaku lwe ndizuukizibwa nga ndi mulamu.
Taata Zakariyya yafuna amawulire ag’essanyu okuva eri bamalayika ng’ayimiridde mu kusaba mu kifo ekitukuvu (mihrab).

location.answer: Ekifo ekitukuvu (mihrab) amawulire amalungi mwe gaalangirirwa

Okumira ensi nga mulamu olw’amalala olw’obugagga
Yasaanawo olw’okubwatuka okw’okubwatuka olw’okusiba eŋŋamira enkazi
Yabbira mu mazzi n’omugenyi ow’amalala mu nnyanja eyawuddwamu

outcome.answer: Emirembe gibeere ku nze olunaku lwe nnazaalibwa, olunaku lwe nfa, n’olunaku lwe ndizuukizibwa nga ndi mulamu

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
